patch_list: Skips banner and native ads entirely and collapses their space in the UI.
Skips the full-screen ads between levels and the ones shown when the app opens.
Blocks rewarded ads, keeps the button visible without a loaded ad and grants the reward instantly.
Stops AppsFlyer, Firebase Analytics and Facebook App Events from being started or sent anything.
